# Pull request template

[Русский — основной язык](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | **English — translation**

## What changed

Describe the actual result in plain language.

## Why this change is needed

Explain the problem or use case.

## How it was verified

List actual commands and results. If a check was unavailable, explain why.

## Limitations and compatibility

Name affected skills, environments, and unverified cases.

## Documentation languages

Change the Russian documentation first, then update its complete English translation within the same change.
